scenes.title: 3 things to know before buying Snailax
scenes.say: Thinking about a Snailax massager? Three things to know first.

scenes.title: Return rules don't match
bullets: Pages disagree on who pays shipping
scenes.say: One. You get thirty days to return an unused item in its box, but Snailax's own policy pages disagree on who pays return shipping. For heavy items, you pay the freight if you change your mind.

scenes.title: Register it for 2 years
bullets: Keep your order and serial number
scenes.say: Two. The warranty is one year, but register within thirty days and the main unit gets two years. Keep your order number and serial number.

scenes.title: Store vs Trustpilot
scenes.say: Three. Best sellers show four point four to four point seven stars from thousands of reviews on the store, but Trustpilot shows two point four from just twenty reviews, mostly about slow support.

scenes.title: Good value, mind the fine print
scenes.say: The good part: free fast US shipping and prices from fifty nine ninety nine. Use code TRUNG3054 for thirty percent off. Our full review is on WiseChoice K R dot com.
